note: Re-judged 2026-10-31 (independent auditor, authored none of b6d84e8104 or the later runOnce commits). RFC 4271 Section 8.2.2 (Idle): "In response to a ManualStart event (Event 1) or an AutomaticStart event (Event 3), the local system: - initializes all BGP resources for the peer connection, - sets ConnectRetryCounter to zero, - starts the ConnectRetryTimer with the initial value, - initiates a TCP connection to the other BGP peer, - listens for a connection that may be initiated by the remote BGP peer, and - changes its state to Connect." Producer changes read: b6d84e8104 added EventDelayOpenTimerExpires and EventBGPOpenWithDelayOpenTimer to handleIdle's ignored arm only; the EventManualStart/EventAutomaticStart arm still calls f.crc.Reset() and EventAutomaticStartWithDampPeerOscillations keeps its own non-zeroing arm. runOnce gained a deferred session.closeConn()/stopSessionTimers(), RFC 8212 export admission (AcceptsAtEnd(isEBGP)), enterEstablished(), warnRFC8212AbsentPolicy() and taskguard panic containment; none touches SetConnectRetryCounter, cycleReachedEstablished, or the start selection (startDamped by default, startAutomatic when the previous cycle reached Established, Event 1 for the first operator start). Tagged units re-read: FSM positive seeds 7 in Idle and requires exactly 0 after Event 3; FSM negative requires Event 6 in Idle to keep 7 and Event 3 outside Idle to keep 7 and the state; peer positives (Event3ZeroesCounter, HoldExpiryInboundShortenedBackoffZeroesCounter, PassiveAutomaticStartReconnectZeroesCounter) require 1 on leaving Established and 0 on the next cycle; peer negatives (FailedCycleRestartKeepsCounter, FailedCycleAfterEstablishedKeepsCounter, FailedCycleInboundShortenedBackoffKeepsCounter) require 1 retained after a cycle that never reached Established. Exact-value assertions; each would fail if Event 3 stopped zeroing or Event 6 started to. All tagged units ran green 2026-10-31 under -race. Caveat: four discrimination records of this row whose producer is runOnce are producer-changed and await re-recording; the exact-value assertions above carry question 2 meanwhile. Resource initialisation, the timer, TCP and listen items are not separately asserted here (sibling rows). Verdict unchanged: enforced.
